events.name: ISO Fest
events.details:
<color=#fff568>ISO Fest</color> Milestone
Gain progress in this event by:
- Upgrading characters to Iso Tier 3 Level 4 & Level 5
- Upgrading characters to Iso Tier 4 Level 3

events.name: KING OF THE NIGHT
events.details:
A decade ago Dracula, Lord of Vampires, faced Blade and the Sorceror Supreme in a climactic confrontation. Forced into a mystic slumber he has slept deep beneath New York while the world above changed. But now a mysterious benefactor reaches out across time and space, awakening the King of the Night once again.

This event requires Fear and Nightreaver characters at increasing power thresholds.

events.name: The Hunger
events.details:
Battle with the Undying team for brains with unique abilities.

Hunger Without End: Start with 10 brains and defeat enemies eating to satiate your hunger.

Hungry: +20% Speed and -8% damage per stack.

Satiated: +20% Damage, +10% Crit Chance, and +10% Crit Damage per stack. Eat your fill at 20 brains and become lethargic for a turn, then gain Undead Fortitude.

Undead Fortitude: Gain 50% damage resistance till the end of combat.

events.name: The Infinity Watch
events.details: After returning to Nexus Earth, Phyla-Vell and Moondragon seek the help of X-Factor Investigations to find the last missing member of the Infinity Watch - Adam Warlock.

events.name: Black & Ebony
events.details: Surrounded by enemies and under attack, the Inhumans are forced to work with Ebony Maw to find a tool to defeat Doctor Doom - three of the Infinity Stones!

events.name: Red Death
events.details: Nick Fury recruits Omega Red to help track down Baron Zemo and put a stop to his carbonadium experiments.

events.name: Unite the Kingdoms
events.details: When corrupted Ultron and Thanos attack the Inhuman capital of Attilan, S.T.R.I.K.E.'s Asgardian forces come to the rescue.

events.name: Like, Totally Jubilee
events.details: A friend of Stature's is stuck in the Microverse and needs a tiny bit of help to save the X-Men. Jubilee teams up with the Pym Tech team to save the X-Men and like, totally all reality.

events.name: Now You See Me
events.details: Invisible Woman must lead a team of Sinister Six to a dimension where a corrupted Spider-Man controls tech that threatens our reality.

events.name: Princess and the Symbiote
events.details: Ultimus has converted the Carnage Symbiote into a dangerous super-soldier serum for his army. With the aid of Spider-Man, Shuri and her fellow Wakandans must find a way to rid Ultimus of this new weapon.

events.name: Phoenix Rising
events.details: When a shard of the Phoenix Force becomes trapped in an alternate dimension, Phoenix rallies Mordo and other Mystic members of S.T.R.I.K.E. to retrieve it and set in motion a plan to imprison Ultimus for good.

events.name: Space Ace
events.details: Nick Fury seeks aid from Star-Lord to stop corrupted Kree forces from utilizing a hybrid Odium serum that will create an unstoppable Super-Soldier army.

events.name: Asteroid M
events.details: After discovering Asteroid M has gone missing, Magneto reluctantly approaches Storm seeking aid. S.T.R.I.K.E.'s X-Men and the Brotherhood must find and recover the base before Ultimus can get his hands on it.

events.name: Chasing Fury
events.details: After agreeing to help the Free Kree resurrect the Supreme Intelligence, Nick Fury has gone missing. The Free Kree must save him in order to finish the work he started.

events.name: Surgical S.T.R.I.K.E.
events.details: Forced underground by the forces of Doom, S.T.R.I.K.E. sends their covert X-Force team to aid an unlikely ally - Doctor Otto Octavius!

events.name: I am Iron Man
events.details: Help Tony Stark and S.H.I.E.L.D. stop a nefarious plot by a mysterious organization.
